tests.name: 4871真实2058公共100%异常执行后才增50并按大于500清异，免疫失败仍增且不补抽，500本身不额外清
tests.assertion: test('4871真实2058公共100%异常执行后才增50并按大于500清异，免疫失败仍增且不补抽，500本身不额外清',()=>{for(const [count,immune,want,cleared]of[[1,false,51,false],[450,false,500,false],[451,false,501,true],[451,true,501,true]]){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=count;if(immune)s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;let seen=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const result=c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});assert.equal(result,!immune);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.wind2058.count,want);assert.equal(!!c.t.ailments['烧伤'],!immune&&!cleared);seen=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(seen,true);assert.equal(s.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,want);if(immune)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);}});

tests.name: 4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印
tests.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','floor','overkill']){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='floor'?1:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,51);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='immune'?0:500);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],mode==='immune');if(mode==='floor'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,500);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(mode==='overkill')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);}const half=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:4500});turn(half);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].hp,4500);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1);assert.equal(sum(half,'fixed'),0);});

tests.name: 4871真实2058低体获得50跨满额先消耗转龙、满HP与PP，已有异常不被额外清；2417实际选择资格随龙属性开启
tests.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体获得50跨满额先消耗转龙、满HP与PP，已有异常不被额外清；2417实际选择资格随龙属性开启',()=>{const s=rawMake({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000});assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),false);s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.a.type,'龙');assert.equal(c.a.hp,9000);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.wind2058.count,0);for(const k of c.a.moves)assert.equal(c.a.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);checked=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(checked,true);assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.windConversions2058.length,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),500);const locked=rawMake({move:38272,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>turn(locked),/有 PP/);assert.equal(locked.fighters[0].pp[key(38272)],1);});

tests.name: 4871真实2058已为龙时满结不消费不再次满回复，风龙资源天敌红减50%与非红不减
tests.assertion: test('4871真实2058已为龙时满结不消费不再次满回复，风龙资源天敌红减50%与非红不减',()=>{for(const foeType of['龙','草']){const a=make({move:20065,soul:true}),b=make({move:20065});for(const s of[a,b]){s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[1].type=foeType;}a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=1000;turn(a,20065,10127);turn(b,20065,10127);const hostile=E.typeEffectiveness(foeType,'龙',a.typeChart)>1;assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),hostile?Math.floor(sum(b,'attack',1)/2):sum(b,'attack',1));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1000);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.windConversions2058,undefined);}const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[1].type='龙';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,300,'独立非红伤害',type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,300);}},()=>turn(s));});

tests.assertion: test('4871真实2058高体回初预约下一回初反转，届时低体仍执行且仅当回合固粉减半，成功后不延续、失败留真实换宠延期',()=>{const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reverseDue,2);s.fighters[0].hp=4000;let reversed=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.t.stages.atk,-1);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.wind2058.reductionRound,2);reversed=true;}if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const [type,n]of[['fixed',500],['percent',500],['true',1000]]){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,1000,'预约反转减伤交互',type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,n);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(reversed,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reverseDue,undefined);s.fighters[0].hp=9000;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,1000,'下一回合独立固定', 'fixed');assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,1000);}},()=>turn(s));const p=make({move:20065,soul:true});turn(p);timer(p,1,'强化保护');turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reductionRound,undefined);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.deferredSwitchLocks[0].implemented,false);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.deferredSwitchLocks[0].duration,2);});
